rules.text: A critical hit on you grants a Will of Fire. In Apex Predator: immunity to cold, and advantage on saves against Bleed, Dazed and Stunned.

Nature check vs DC 5 to predict a body of water's weather, tides and visibility. Swimming, allies within 20 feet can spend their Action to follow your trail. 10 minutes submerged: remove 1 rank of Exhaustion (once per rest).

activities.label: Apex Predator
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 minute. Again before a long rest (before a rest at 11th): 1 rank of Exhaustion.

rules.text: Use the card for your level (its Cold Blooded and Efficient Recovery numbers grow).
Two Predator Traits (more at 7th and 15th): the option items.
The Demoralize skill action as a Bonus action, any number of times (not once an hour). 7th: +1 rank of Demoralized. 15th: all creatures you can see within 20 feet.
Your hit points and chakra points increase by your level (add them on the sheet).
A Summoning Technique contract with the Shark tribe; your sharks arrive in a water bubble and move on land at half their swimming speed.
Blindsight 10 feet (20 at 7th, doubled while submerged; 30 at 15th). Set it on the sheet.

activities.label: Shark Skinned: melee retaliation (11th)
activities.text: 11th: a creature damaging you with a melee attack.

rules.text: Bonus DR equal to your Constitution modifier while not in Heavy Armor (turn the effect off in Heavy Armor).

activities.label: Tide Locked
activities.text: Once per turn, cold damage from your Water Release jutsu: one affected creature. Failure: −10 speed until the end of its next turn (20 at 7th, 30 at 15th), or +2 chakra damage taken until the start of your next turn (+4 at 7th, +6 at 15th).

activities.label: Bite
activities.text: In place of an Attack action attack; +1 critical range.

activities.label: Bite: grapple (7th)
activities.text: A damaged creature. Failure: Grappled (15th: and 1 rank of Bleed).

activities.label: Angler Lure
activities.text: Bonus action, a creature in range. Failure: 1 rank of Shaken, and disadvantage on attacks against others than you until the end of its next turn.

roll.note: Reaction to damage: reduce it by your [Weapon Damage] (roll your weapon's damage).

rules.text: 1 Downtime: two grafts on one weapon (new ones replace them). Raking Dermis: Pierce 2, slashing or piercing. Wing Guard: Blocking 1 and the parry. Sawtooth: once per turn your [Weapon Damage] first drops temporary hit points or chakra to 0. Scale Plate: Fortified. Tiger Pattern: hit two or more creatures on your turn: +2 DR each until your next turn. Marlin Imprint: 2 ranks of Mastery underwater. Angler Lure: the save button. Set the weapon's properties on the item.

activities.label: King of the Deep
activities.text: Action, once per long rest: water within 120 feet becomes a 30-foot radius maelstrom on you for 1 minute.

activities.label: Maelstrom: end of turn
activities.text: A hostile creature ending its turn inside (as your Water Release Ninjutsu).

rules.text: Inside: submerged; difficult terrain for enemies; allies swim freely; enemies' ranged attacks into or through it have disadvantage; your melee attacks have Reach 2 and pull 5 feet; Fire jutsu lose 4 fire damage dice; hostile jutsu cost 8 more and lose 2 damage dice, and you gain temporary chakra by its rank (D 2 ... S 6).
After a long rest pick two Predator Surges (the option items); one surge per trigger. Their saves use your highest jutsu save DC.
Taking damage from a creature: mark it until the end of your next turn; you know where it is even if invisible or hidden.
Casting a Water Release jutsu on a creature behind a Barrier: half the damage also reaches creatures the Barrier protects.
A melee hit: Grappled (no reactions), you move up to twice your speed dragging it, then the grapple ends.
Reaction, a creature damages you with a melee attack: take the Attack action against it.

activities.label: Predators Rend
activities.text: A melee attack's damage. Failure: its DR is 2 lower for 1 minute (stacks up to 3 times).

rules.text: Casting an area Water Release jutsu: the area is difficult terrain for 1 minute for all but you and up to 3 creatures; a creature can spend 10 chakra to ignore it until the end of its turn.
